statement: Let L' = L + dmu, with mu an (n-1)-form in the same parent field bundle and fixed boundary class.
limitation: defines the component only; it does not classify all MTS boundary terms

statement: theta' = theta + delta mu follows from delta L' = E delta Phi + d(theta + delta mu).
limitation: requires parent variation identity for the selected sector

statement: Q'_v = Q_v + i_v mu up to corner/exact terms for a fixed vertical generator v.
limitation: corner/topological remainders are explicitly excluded from this component

statement: delta(i_v mu) - i_v(delta mu) = 0 when [delta,i_v]=0 and the surface embedding is fixed.
limitation: field-dependent tau/v or moving surfaces are moved to epsilon_Bv_tau_surface_commutator

statement: epsilon_Bv_exact_fixed_primitive = abs(int_S(delta(i_v mu)-i_v(delta mu)))/M_ref = 0 for this component.
limitation: zero numerator only; M_ref and other Bv components remain open

statement: epsilon_Bv_ambiguity is not zero unless corner, topological, tau/surface, unfixed-reference, projector-boundary and denominator clauses close too.
